name: Single-disc
blurb: Play the whole game from one Disc 1 image on Highwind. Merges Highwind Disc 2/3 field maps onto Disc 1 and adds Supernova. Ending/credits movies auto-apply with this option.
hint: Use one Disc 1 image for the full Highwind game.
